details: Synthetic demonstration dataset; not actual company records.
Current quantity_on_hand is reconciled to opening_quantity plus all signed stock movements.
Each transfer is represented by a TRANSFER_OUT and TRANSFER_IN row sharing one reference_no.
All quantities are positive; movement_type determines whether stock increases or decreases.
KPIs, category value, stock status, warehouse comparison, monthly receipts/issues, top products, low-stock alerts.
For a real SCM deployment, validate product costs, reorder thresholds, warehouse capacity and supplier details with the organization.
